entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane whose main planet is covered by one vast city, ruled by ten guilds under the Guildpact.

entities.name: City of Ravnica
entities.description: The vast metropolis whose name has become synonymous with the entire plane, made up of ten districts.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: A living enchantment signed by ten factions that ended Ravnica's wars and bound the guilds for more than ten millennia.

entities.name: Living Guildpact
entities.description: A person who holds the power of the Guildpact; any law he or she verbally confirms becomes binding.

entities.name: Azor I
entities.description: The leader who proposed the Guildpact and left a contingency plan in case it was broken.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: A network of leylines across Ravnica's districts left by Azor I as a test of guild cooperation to secure a new Guildpact.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The police force, legislative and judicial body of Ravnica's bureaucracy.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A standing army that protects the Guildpact.

entities.name: League of Wojek
entities.description: The official peacekeepers of the City of Ravnica, part of the Boros Legion.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The guild of secret services, recently thought extinct.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: A guild of thrill-killers providing labor, catering and entertainment.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The guild managing food production and organic waste disposal.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: A loose affiliation of berserker clans who seek to wipe civilization from the plane.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild responsible for civil engineering and new magical developments.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: A guild of religion, trade and banking.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The nature-based religious guild of Ravnica.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The guild that provides medical assistance and performs biological research.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: The Selesnya parun, who is Ravnica's Worldsoul.

entities.name: Erstwhile
entities.description: A delicate race of elves once important on Ravnica, who returned as Zombie Attendants of Vraska.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker from Ravnica who petrified Isperia and later led the Phyrexian invasion force against Ravnica.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A human Boros officer whose arrest of Szadek broke the Guildpact.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: The head of the Dimir arrested by Agrus Kos.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: A sphinx guildleader who proposed cooperation and was petrified by Vraska.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker on whom the power of the new Guildpact was bestowed, becoming the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet dragon, called the Firemind, who sought to fight Bolas and later became the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker Izzet ally who turned Project Lightning Bug into the Interplanar Beacon.

entities.name: Project Lightning Bug
entities.description: An Izzet project turned into a beacon to call other planeswalkers.

entities.name: Interplanar Beacon
entities.description: The beacon activated to call planeswalkers to Ravnica.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon who invaded Ravnica with an army of Eternals and claimed dominion over the plane.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: A planeswalker who led the Gruul in an effort to tip Ravnica into chaos.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A Vedalken who activated the Immortal Sun to trap the planeswalkers.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: The artifact that trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers led by Chandra Nalaar, Jace Beleren and Gideon Jura.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker and Gatewatch leader.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped the Boros reclaim the Ninth District.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped repel the Phyrexian invasion of Ravnica.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The Invasion Tree that Vraska directed at New Prahv.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: The Azorius Senate's guild hall.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnya hometree where the guild leaders gathered, destroyed during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Chamber of the Guildpact
entities.description: The chamber destroyed in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: An archon who leads the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: An agency pivotal in maintaining peace on Ravnica after the invasions.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Host of the celebration at Karlov Manor, killed three days later.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: A Simic speaker assassinated at Karlov Manor.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A Dimir member arrested as a suspect and later helped to escape.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: The planeswalker enlisted to lead the Karlov Manor investigation.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: The detective who solved the Karlov Manor murders.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The Boros leader who gave Kaya 24 hours to find the mastermind.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A goblin boss targeted in an assassination attempt.

entities.name: Anzrag
entities.description: The Gruul god who rampaged through the Agency headquarters.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: A Rakdos figure who captured Agrus Kos and usurped the guild.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The Selesnya Worldsoul figure, specifically Oba, who organized the murders.

entities.name: Wanderer
entities.description: A planeswalker searching for Nashi on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A person who disappeared through a mysterious doorway on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane where Nashi disappeared.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: A plane connected to Ravnica by an interplanar relay.

entities.name: Omenport
entities.description: A town on Thunder Junction where a relay tower was built.

entities.name: Omenpath Project
entities.description: Niv-Mizzet's project to regulate and map the Omenpaths on Ravnica.

entities.name: Rift Crisis
entities.description: A crisis on Dominaria that isolated Ravnica from the rest of the Multiverse.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: The event after which Ravnica's ghost-world anomaly dissolved.

entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: The ten-thousand-year celebration during which the Guildpact was broken.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war in which Bolas attacked Ravnica and the planeswalkers fought him.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion in which Vraska led forces against Ravnica.

entities.name: Utvara Valley
entities.description: A ruined landscape east of the City of Ravnica where the Schism once was.

entities.name: Schism over Utvara
entities.description: The rift that snagged the spirit realm of Agyrem to Utvara.

entities.name: Agyrem
entities.description: The spirit realm that was snagged onto Ravnica.

events.summary: Ten factions sign the Guildpact to end Ravnica's centuries of war, becoming the ten guilds.
events.quote: Each of the ten factions signed the Guildpact

events.summary: The Rift Crisis isolates Ravnica from the rest of the Multiverse.
events.quote: it became isolated from the rest of the Multiverse

events.summary: After the Mending the ghost-world anomaly dissolves and trapped spirits can pass on.
events.quote: the Ravnican ghost-world anomaly was dissolved, and the trapped spirits were able to pass on to the aether

events.summary: At the Decamillennial, Agrus Kos arrests the Dimir head Szadek and unwittingly breaks the Guildpact.
events.quote: the Guildpact was unwittingly broken when Agrus Kos arrested Szadek

events.summary: The ancient balance is shattered and Ravnica is thrown into chaos.
events.quote: The ancient balance was shattered, and Ravnica was thrown into chaos.

events.summary: The guilds are officially disbanded during the Interregnum.
events.quote: the guilds were officially disbanded

events.summary: The former guilds reestablish, many under new leadership.
events.quote: they reestablished, many under new leadership

events.summary: The Izzet discover Azor I's contingency plan; the power of a new Guildpact is bestowed on Jace, who becomes the Living Guildpact.
events.quote: That power was eventually bestowed upon Jace Beleren

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet reveals the threat of Bolas and has Ral Zarek turn Project Lightning Bug into a beacon.
events.quote: he has Ral Zarek turn Project Lightning Bug into a beacon to call other planeswalkers to help fight Bolas

events.summary: Vraska petrifies the sphinx Isperia at the guild summit, shattering hopes for cooperation.
events.quote: Vraska petrified the sphinx.

events.summary: Ral Zarek activates the Interplanar Beacon as Nicol Bolas arrives on the plane.
events.quote: Ral Zarek activated the Interplanar Beacon and at the same time Nicol Bolas arrived on the plane.

events.summary: Domri Rade leads the Gruul in an effort to tip the world into chaos.
events.quote: Domri Rade led the Gruul in a concerted effort to tip the world into chaos.

events.summary: Bolas attacks the cityplane, leading to the death of Niv-Mizzet.
events.quote: Bolas arrives and attacks the cityplane, leading to the death of Niv-Mizzet

events.summary: Dovin Baan activates the Immortal Sun to trap the planeswalkers.
events.quote: Dovin Baan later activates the Immortal Sun to trap the planeswalkers

events.summary: Bolas is defeated and a resurrected Niv-Mizzet becomes the new Living Guildpact.
events.quote: In the end, Bolas was defeated, and a resurrected Niv-Mizzet became the new Living Guildpact.

events.summary: Vraska leads the Phyrexian invasion force against Ravnica, directing Realmbreaker at New Prahv.
events.quote: Vraska led the Phyrexian invasion force against her home plane

events.summary: Vraska orders Ravnicans blinded in vengeance for her fellow gorgons.
events.quote: she ordered Ravnicans to be blinded

events.summary: Ral Zarek defeats Vraska and her forces with a sonic weapon attuned against the oil.
events.quote: Zarek able to defeat Vraska and her forces with a sonic weapon attuned against the oil

events.summary: At Karlov Manor, Zegana is assassinated and Etrata is arrested as a suspect.
events.quote: During the celebration, Zegana was assassinated, and Etrata was arrested as a suspect, though she maintained her innocence.

events.summary: Teysa Karlov is killed three days later.
events.quote: Three days later, Teysa was killed as well.

events.summary: The Gruul god Anzrag is released and rampages through the Agency headquarters.
events.quote: the Gruul god Anzrag was released and rampaged through the Agency headquarters, killing multiple agents

events.summary: Proft solves the case, revealing Trostani as the mastermind behind the murders.
events.quote: Before open war could be declared, Proft was able to solve the case.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet recognizes the Omenpaths as a threat and devises a plan to regulate them.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet recognized their patterns as a significant threat to the plane.

events.summary: Ral Zarek builds an interplanar relay tower at Omenport on Thunder Junction.
events.quote: Ral traveled to Thunder Junction and oversaw the construction of a relay tower in the town of Omenport

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet assists the Wanderer in her search for Nashi.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet assisted the Wanderer in her search for Nashi

relations.quote: Azor I had created a contingency plan that would take effect if the magic of the Guildpact was ever broken

relations.note: He led the Gruul in an effort to cause chaos.
Niv-Mizzet has Ral turn the project into a beacon.
relations.quote: he has Ral Zarek turn Project Lightning Bug into a beacon

relations.note: Niv-Mizzet died in Bolas's attack and was later resurrected.
relations.quote: leading to the death of Niv-Mizzet

relations.note: The Erstwhile returned as her Zombie Attendants.
relations.quote: They returned as Zombie Attendants of Vraska
Ravnica's Worldsoul is the Selesnya parun Mat'Selesnya
